objective: Substantial source-verified expansion, current reviewer baseline, then one research-backed candidate and equivalent comparison; no merge.

execution.retries: No quality-selected retries, --against, or --fail; resume incomplete technical work only under identical identities. Initial --fresh follows private archival of the aborted ledger.
execution.budget: One baseline plus one candidate on this frozen complete cohort; six concurrent rows. No configured Sol dollar estimate is available. Aborted earlier run recorded 28.1 seconds per completed task; 1164 tasks / 6 suggests about 91 minutes before startup, tail and runtime variation. This is a scheduling estimate, not a cost guarantee.

reserve.exposure: All source and qualifications are investigator-exposed. Reviewer outcomes for this reserve remain unread until the candidate implementation, assets and settings are frozen. This is outcome-protected regression confirmation, not source-unseen or independent human ground truth.
reserve.selection: SHA-256 seeded order within label-composition strata of wholly new families; original146 and the previously development-exposed Vue family are ineligible.

measurement.interpretation: Label agreement, not factual precision; historical13.9% label-noise reference retained. Source-derived labels and correlated families limit inference. No outcome-based relabeling or exclusion.
measurement.decision: Report every paired transition on the frozen set and reserve; do not trade a bug-detection regression for a cleaner headline. An improvement claim requires improved clean acceptance with no lower observed bug detection, separately disclosed on the reserve. Uncertainty and non-improvement are reportable results.
